summary: Add explicitly requested Darwin finite-execution slot custody

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: Darwin executions persist their operation-bound slot identity in the existing scope record. Retirement proofs gain an optional Darwin receipt; existing systemd proofs remain readable. The new root helper owns separate slot binding and audit files.

rules.detail: Only explicitly authorized finite launches request a Darwin slot. Ordinary execution and PTY seats remain detached; admission policy is unchanged. Retirement requires matching job identity and an empty effective-or-real UID union, never only supervisor exit.

compatibility.detail: Adds the fractal-mac-custody package and run/cancel/leftovers/sample protocol. A requested slot fails with helperUnavailable without the pinned authorized helper. Older runtimes cannot own the new Darwin retirement contract; retire active slot jobs before rolling back.

downtime.detail: No automatic service restart or slot activation.

manual.detail: Operators must separately provision the login-less slot identity, shared workspace and narrowly pinned sudo rules, with use_pty and log_output disabled. Root acceptance and explicit admission integration are required before enabling slot execution.

recovery.detail: RetirementUnknown retains the root binding and prevents reuse. Use matching-job cancellation and operator inspection; do not delete a binding or infer retirement from a vanished supervisor.
